sources.use: Complete 23-check registry, categories, dependencies, weights, and result semantics
Agent self-registration, status polling, claim/human fallback, and rate-limit pattern; private-key return is explicitly not adopted
Human email plus OTP activation flow
Stable machine error codes, recovery guidance, and idempotency errors
Agent-created account with optional short-lived human claim flow and local key storage
Verified inbox as identity-linking source of truth and fail-closed ambiguity
Stronger re-authentication precaution when linking distinct credentials
GitHub skill installation and badge contract
Catalog identity, install URL, and public skill page metadata
Single-use claim, 0600 local auth file, bounded telemetry, and explicit consent patterns
Registration, scoped key, balance, preview, project, workflow, run, status, and report discovery

identity_policy: Require mailbox activation or a positively provider-verified email. Fail closed on missing, unverified, ambiguous, or provider-mismatched email. For manual linking of distinct credentials, require authenticated control of the existing account as the stronger Auth0-style precaution.
